mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns following 3-month FEDFUNDS declines are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.0% (as of most recent monthly data), it signals labor market tightening that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns following UNRATE < 3.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth rate exceeds 1.5% and unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains below 3.5%, it indicates strong economic momentum with low labor market slack, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns following INDPRO growth > 1.5% and UNRATE < 3.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth > 3.5%), higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite cause S&P 500 underperformance over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns following monetary tightening cycle condition are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts index (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns following 3-month HOUST rises are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly employment change (PAYEMS) growth rate exceeds 0.5% year-over-year, it indicates robust labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns following PAYEMS growth > 0.5% YoY are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400 units and residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 680,000 million dollars (as of most recent monthly data), it indicates strong housing market and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns following HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 680000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply expansion regime (defined by INDPRO growth rate > 1.0% and quarterly GDP growth rate > 0.5% as measured by GDPC1), strong economic growth and corporate earnings momentum drive S&P 500 outperformance over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate > 1.0% and GDPC1 growth rate > 0.5% QoQ
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns following supply expansion regime condition are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
